Contract EnterValidatedCreditReferencesModule::chooseLoanRequest(requestid: Integer): LoanRequest {
	definition:
		selectedLoanRequest: LoanRequest = CurrentLoanRequests->any(lr|lr.RequestID = requestid)
	precondition:
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(selectedLoanRequest) and
		selectedLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		selectedLoanRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::REFERENCESVALIDATED and
		CurrentLoanRequest = selectedLoanRequest and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(selectedLoanRequest) and
		result = selectedLoanRequest
}
